he: בְּאוֹתָהּ שָׁעָה עָלָה אוֹקְיָינוֹס וְהֵצִיף שְׁלִישׁוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם. אָמַר לָהֶם הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: אַתֶּם עֲשִׂיתֶם מַעֲשֶׂה חָדָשׁ וּקְרָאתֶם לְעַצְמְכֶם, אַף אֲנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה מַעֲשֶׂה חָדָשׁ וְאֶקְרָא לְעַצְמִי, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (עמוס ה ח) ״הַקּוֹרֵא לְמֵי הַיָּם וַיִּשְׁפְּכֵם״ וְגוֹ׳. רַבִּי יִצְחָק אוֹמֵר: אִלּוּ נִפְרַט שְׁמָהּ שֶׁל עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה לֹא סִפְּקוּ לָהֶם כָּל עֲיָירוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: לָמָּה נִקְרָא שְׁמָם ״אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים״? שֶׁמְּחַדְּשִׁים לָהֶם אֱלוֹהוּת בְּכָל יוֹם, שֶׁאִם הָיָה שֶׁל זָהָב וְצָרִיךְ לוֹ – עוֹשֵׂהוּ שֶׁל כֶּסֶף, שֶׁל כֶּסֶף – עוֹשֵׂהוּ שֶׁל נְחֹשֶׁת, שֶׁל נְחֹשֶׁת – עוֹשֵׂהוּ שֶׁל בַּרְזֶל, בַּרְזֶל – עוֹשֵׂהוּ שֶׁל בְּדִיל, בְּדִיל – עוֹשֵׂהוּ שֶׁל עוֹפֶרֶת, שֶׁל עוֹפֶרֶת וְצָרִיךְ לוֹ – עוֹשֵׂהוּ שֶׁל עֵץ.
en:
At that very moment, Okeanos87Literally, “Ocean.” “Okeanos” is the mythologized form of Amos’ mei hayam (Am.5:8), and a close relative of Tiamat (tehom; Gn.1:2). arose
and drenched a third of the world.
The Blessed Holy One said to that [generation]:
By initiating on your own this call
[upon the gods by the Name of God],
you have been unprecedented.
I, too, will do something unprecedented,
by calling upon Okeanos
[by My Name]!
[For it is said:
“He calls forth the waters of the Sea, and pours them out . . .
HASHEM is His Name!” (Am.5:8).88=Mechilta Ishmael, bakhodesh 6.
12. R. Isaac says:
If the names of the [objects venerated by] foreign cults were all listed,
the world would not last long enough to punish them all!89=Mechilta Ishmael, bakhodesh 5.
R. Eliezer says:
Why are they referred to as “other gods?”
Because every day their servants make a new divinity.
If he had one of gold, and he [later] needed the gold,
he’d replace it [with another one] of silver.
If he needed the silver one,
he’d replace it [with another one] of copper.
If he needed the copper one,
he’d replace it [with another one] of iron.
If he needed the one of iron,
he’d replace it [with another one] of tin.
If he needed the one of tin,
he’d replace it [with another one] of lead.
If he needed the one of lead,
he’d replace it [with another one] of wood.90//Mechilta Ishmael, bakhodesh 6. The value of the material diminishes with each iteration of the idol.
